en: Black-and-white postcard view of a quiet city street lined with mid‑20th‑century apartment buildings. Parked vintage cars stand along the right side of the cobbled road, with a sidewalk and old-style street lamps. In the distance, a church tower with a clock dominates the skyline. Trees frame the right edge. The text "VÄNERSBORG Kyrkogatan" appears in the lower-left corner, and the number "55577" appears in the lower-right corner.
